competitors.product: Copilot Business / Enterprise + coding agent + Agent HQ
competitors.category: AI dev platform; agent orchestration; governance
capabilities: cloud coding agent that opens PRs
Agent HQ mission control across own and third-party agents (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Cognition, xAI)
control plane: agent/model access policies, audit logging (public preview)
self-review by coding agent before human review
competitors.pricing: Business $19/seat/mo (1,900 AI credits); Enterprise $39/seat/mo (3,900 credits); individual Pro $10, Pro+ $39, Max $100; 1 credit = $0.01; third-party agents included in paid Copilot

competitors.overlapWithEchelon: HIGH: owns the PR/CI surface where Echelon's completion evidence would be checked; control plane + audit + code quality cover the generic governance story.
